use default
use IO.Std.read_line
use System.Random

let size = 8
let random = Random(17)

use Cell = (row: int, column: int)

let atoms = SET[Cell]()

while atoms.count < 4 do
    atoms.add((row = random.next(size), column = random.next(size)))
od

let guesses = SET[Cell]()

use Beam = (row: int, column: int, dr: int, dc: int)

entrance(point: int) -> Beam =>
    let side = (point - 1) / size in
    let offset = (point - 1) % size in
    let back = size - 1 - offset in
    case side
    when 0 then (row = -1, column = offset, dr = 1, dc = 0)
    when 1 then (row = offset, column = size, dr = 0, dc = -1)
    when 2 then (row = size, column = back, dr = -1, dc = 0)
    else (row = back, column = -1, dr = 0, dc = 1)
    esac

point_at(cell: Cell) -> int =>
    if cell.row < 0 then cell.column + 1
    elif cell.column >= size then size + cell.row + 1
    elif cell.row >= size then 2 * size + size - cell.column
    else 3 * size + size - cell.row
    fi

inside(row: int, column: int) -> bool =>
    row >= 0 /\ row < size /\ column >= 0 /\ column < size

atom(row: int, column: int) -> bool =>
    atoms.contains((row = row, column = column))

fire(point: int) -> string is
    let start = entrance(point)
    let dr mut = start.dr
    let dc mut = start.dc
    let row mut = start.row
    let column mut = start.column
    let first mut = true

    while first \/ inside(row, column) do
        let ahead_row = row + dr
        let ahead_column = column + dc

        if atom(ahead_row, ahead_column) then
            return "hit"
        fi

        let left = atom(ahead_row + dc, ahead_column + dr)
        let right = atom(ahead_row - dc, ahead_column - dr)

        if left \/ right then
            if first \/ (left /\ right) then
                return "reflected"
            fi

            let turned_dr = if left then -dc else dc fi
            let turned_dc = if left then -dr else dr fi
            dr = turned_dr
            dc = turned_dc
            continue
        fi

        row = ahead_row
        column = ahead_column
        first = false
    od

    let exit = point_at((row = row, column = column))

    if exit == point then "reflected" else "exits at {exit}" fi
si

show(reveal: bool) is
    for row in 0..size do
        let cells =
            (0..size)
                |> map(column =>
                    let cell = (row = row, column = column) in
                    let guessed = guesses.contains(cell) in
                    if reveal /\ atoms.contains(cell) then
                        if guessed then "X" else "*" fi
                    elif guessed then "o"
                    else "."
                    fi)
                |> join(" ")

        write_line("{row + 1} {cells}")
    od

    write_line("  {(1::size) |> join(" ")}")
si

write_line("four atoms are hidden in an 8 x 8 box")
write_line("beams enter at 1-8 along the top, 9-16 down the right side,")
write_line("17-24 back along the bottom and 25-32 up the left side")
write_line("commands: fire <1-32>, guess <row> <column>, done")

let cost mut = 0

while let line = read_line() do
    write_line("> {line}")

    let words =
        line.split([' '], System.StringSplitOptions.REMOVE_EMPTY_ENTRIES)

    if words.count == 2 /\ words[0] =~ "fire" then
        let point = int.parse(words[1])
        let result = fire(point)
        cost = cost + if result.starts_with("exits") then 2 else 1 fi
        write_line("beam {point}: {result}")
    elif words.count == 3 /\ words[0] =~ "guess" then
        let cell = (
            row = int.parse(words[1]) - 1,
            column = int.parse(words[2]) - 1)

        if !guesses.remove(cell) then
            guesses.add(cell)
        fi

        show(false)
    elif words.count == 1 /\ words[0] =~ "done" then
        let missed =
            atoms |> filter(a => !guesses.contains(a)) |> count()

        show(true)
        write_line("X is a right guess, * a missed atom, o a wrong guess")
        write_line("score {cost + 5 * missed}; lower is better")
        break
    else
        write_line("commands: fire <1-32>, guess <row> <column>, done")
    fi
od
